coverage.detail: 21 approved comments in all. The REST API shows approved comments only, and does not split them by type.

Read a sample of 7 pages: the home page and up to 3 pages of each type, at most 30. Pages outside the sample are not read. Builders, shortcodes and blocks are counted from the REST content of 123 items, not from this sample.
Menus are not read at level 1; names, items and locations need level 2 or 3.
Found from asset paths, SEO comments and REST namespaces only; plugins with no front-end trace do not show. The full list needs level 3.
Read 6 namespaces; 6 lists paged to the end.
Read 5 sitemaps listed in the index at /sitemap_index.xml.
Media items listed; files are not downloaded.
3 published items, every page read; drafts and private items need level 3.
120 published items, every page read; drafts and private items need level 3.
Added URLs that no list names, from post dates and counts: 26 date archives and 17 later list pages. The last page of a list is a guess at 10 posts per page (the WordPress default).
Only authors with published posts are listed; user counts by role need level 3.
